scope: read-only eligibility and provenance review; no render, inference, build, or audio upload

decision.single_experimental_candidate_method: continuous excitation plus whole-view trusted-band projection
decision.eligibility: conditional for one controlled listening comparison only; not yet an authenticated full-song candidate
decision.reason: The combined method has the strongest procedural boundary-consistency result and passes the development protected-band gate, but there is no full-song integration or real-song evidence. Forced no-loss controls show false residual edits, target-aligned complex error conflicts with magnitude metrics, and the available Smooth receipt is not hash-bound to its historical input or executable.

recommended_real_song.input_sha256_scope: hash of the file present during this read-only audit; the archived run did not store an input hash, so equality with the historical run input is not proven
recommended_real_song.why_selected: Existing full-song Smooth run, matching local source path is present, and its Smooth FLAC is present. The separate 216.4-second Chasing Horizons (1) original input named by an older run is absent, so it is not eligible for a reproducible candidate from that source.

available_smooth_reference.status: usable historical listening reference, but not an exact reproducibility anchor until input and binary identities are re-established

candidate_evidence.target_fidelity: not established: continuous excitation slightly worsened target-aligned complex NMSE in the recorded procedural comparison while magnitude LSD improved
candidate_evidence.false_edit_controls: continuous plus projection still added residual to exact no-extra-loss stopped-mid input; a separate forced healthy procedural control showed residual RMS growth of 2.71-3.07%. These forced-policy controls do not estimate autonomous activation on real music, but bar a claim that continuity or projection makes healthy-source edits safe.
candidate_evidence.integration_status: isolated patch only; no full-song real-input candidate, complete production pipeline qualification, or owner preference result

evidence_tiers.tier_2: tool, hash, geometry, and development numerical gates

candidate_evidence.development_chunk_geometry: The continuous-plus-projection development comparison used 8-second chunks with 2-second overlap; the selected Smooth full-song run used 10-second chunks with 2-second overlap. Candidate behavior at the recorded Smooth geometry is unverified.

gaps_and_gates.required: Use the present input SHA above to create a hash-bound baseline with a clean, verified 493cdca-equivalent executable; retain executable SHA256, all settings, mastered.wav, listen.wav, master.json, and output hashes. Do not use the dirty historical run as though its source and binary were authenticated.

Freeze one 24-32 second passage from the input alone before candidate output is viewed. Choose an active passage containing sustained decay and multiple input-derived onsets, crossing several 10-second chunk boundaries with the recorded 2-second overlap. Current retained run receipts contain aggregate onset counts, not timestamps, so this review does not invent an interval.

On the same predeclared excerpt and pinned input, compare Euler8 restart/projection and continuous/projection in two hop-aligned shifted layouts using the recorded Smooth geometry (10-second chunks, 2-second overlap), identical weights, gain, and Smooth finalization. Retain boundary-interior residual RMS/correlation, protected-band error, complex and magnitude error separately, fixed input-derived transient/decay windows, stereo metrics, pre-finalizer and final outputs. Require the existing 1e-6 absolute protected-band gate; do not tune on a target.

Include an unchanged/no-addition control and identify where the frozen base policy abstains before reading candidate results. Since the real song has no clean target, treat edit magnitude as a risk diagnostic and listening question, not evidence of correction.

Use identical Smooth finalization and report output after limiting. The existing observer does not retain the true pre-limiter signal; do not claim transient or ambience survival from pre-finalizer-only measurements.

listening_boundary: If provenance is re-established and the fixed real excerpt gates do not reveal a fatal protected-band or false-edit issue, one full-song pair may be prepared for blind owner preference. Label it an experimental listening candidate. It cannot establish restoration accuracy, healthy-input safety, broad preference, or production promotion.
